# Natural Earth US/Canada administrative reference

Source: Natural Earth 1:50 million Admin 1 states/provinces, release 5.1.1 (2022), tag `v5.1.1`, commit `9380cca83db5f9aef52d5e762765100745f84b27`.

Natural Earth data is in the public domain. The terms state that its raster and vector data may be used, modified and distributed for commercial or noncommercial purposes without permission. Attribution is retained here voluntarily. Linked historical narratives and third-party source pages keep their own rights.

- [Dataset description](https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/50m-cultural-vectors/50m-admin-1-states-provinces/)
- [Natural Earth terms](https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/)
- [Pinned source](https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/blob/9380cca83db5f9aef52d5e762765100745f84b27/geojson/ne_50m_admin_1_states_provinces.geojson)

The atlas selects 51 USA features (50 states and the District of Columbia) and 13 CAN features. US overseas territories are outside this selection. Coordinates are rounded to four decimal places and ring traversal is closed/reversed for D3 spherical rendering. Original vertices otherwise remain; no historical extent is reconstructed. The source English name for DC is Washington; the interface disambiguates it as District of Columbia without altering the source feature.

The metadata manifest retains the source commit, input hash, transformations, output hashes, byte counts and inspection date. Modern administrative reference geometry is separate from historical snapshot membership and the atlas's original narrative license.
